optimized_sql:
WITH
pi_matches AS (
    SELECT pi.person_id
    FROM person_info AS pi
    JOIN info_type AS it ON it.id = pi.info_type_id
    WHERE pi.note = 'Volker Boehm'
      AND it.info = 'mini biography'
),
n_matches AS (
    SELECT n.id, n.name
    FROM name AS n
    WHERE n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
      AND n.gender = 'm'
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS of_person,
       MIN(t.title) AS biography_movie
FROM n_matches AS n
JOIN pi_matches AS pi ON pi.person_id = n.id
JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ci.person_id, tt.title
    FROM cast_info AS ci
    JOIN title AS tt ON tt.id = ci.movie_id
    JOIN movie_link AS ml ON ml.linked_movie_id = ci.movie_id
    JOIN link_type AS lt ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id
    WHERE tt.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
      AND lt.link = 'features'
) AS t ON t.person_id = n.id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM aka_name AS an
    WHERE an.person_id = n.id
      AND an.name LIKE '%a%'
)
